facts.about: Reliance was founded by Dhirubhai Ambani and is now promoted and managed by his elder son, Mukesh Dhirubhai Ambani. Ambani's family has about 50% shareholding in the conglomerate.

flags.text: Cash-rich profits: 5-yr operating cash = 190% of PAT
Latest quarter growth (+30%) accelerating vs 3-yr trend (+6%)

business.summary: Reliance Industries Limited is a diversified conglomerate operating in Oil to Chemicals (O2C), Oil and Gas, Retail, and Digital Services. It generates revenue through refining, petrochemicals, consumer retail, digital connectivity, and media and entertainment services.

segments.name: Oil to Chemicals (O2C)
segments.note: Includes refining, petrochemicals, fuel retailing, and bulk wholesale marketing.

segments.name: Oil and Gas
segments.note: Focuses on exploration, development, and production of crude oil and gas.

segments.name: Retail
segments.note: Covers consumer retail and a range of related services.

segments.name: Digital Services
segments.note: Provides a range of digital connectivity and related services.

guidance.statement: Tracking annualized EBITDA well over Rs.80,000 Crores for the first half of FY 2027.
guidance.quote: So, when you look at the first half of FY 2027 performance, it is in our minds tracking annualized EBITDA well over Rs.80,000 Crores and I think this is something, it just tells you how the markets are.

guidance.statement: Earnings contribution definitely starting in FY 2028.
guidance.quote: And on new energy, I just wanted to say that it is accelerating and we see the benefit, earnings contribution definitely starting in FY 2028.

guidance.statement: We see visibility of high teen growth for Jio.
guidance.quote: We are able to, in our minds at least, we see visibility of high teen growth for Jio, and those are the points that Akash was talking about.

guidance.statement: Benefits of scale will be seen through FY 2028 and FY 2029.
guidance.quote: And the benefit of all this will be seen through FY 2028 and FY 2029 when this conversion of this scale will translate in terms of value.

guidance.statement: We are looking to double our absolute EBITDA number over the next three years.
guidance.quote: So, we are looking at growing our online businesses pretty rapidly during this year... the benefit of that scale will convert into value in terms of margins and cash generation over the next two years.

guidance.statement: The target is to take this to Rs.1 lakh Crores on FY2030.
guidance.quote: we have anyway announced the target is to kind of take this to Rs.1 lakh Crores on FY2030.

guidance.statement: We expect the ceiling price to trend upwards and go towards $9.9 in the second half.
guidance.quote: As such, like I mentioned, currently the ceiling price is $8.9, which is almost $1.14 lower than what it was the previous half. But again, we expect this to trend upwards and go towards $9.9 in the second half.

guidance.statement: We aim to commission these factories in next few quarters.
guidance.quote: and the work on commissioning of polysilicon, ingot, wafer, solar cell and glass continue to progress well and we aim to commission these factories in next few quarters.

guidance.statement: Aggregate retail revenue growth will continue to deliver double-digit figures.
guidance.quote: Aggregate basis will continue to deliver double-digit revenues.

guidance.statement: We expect organic ARPU growth of 5% to 6% per year.
guidance.quote: Organically, if we can improve our ARPU by 5% to 6% a year, I think that is a good number, good place to be in.

guidance.statement: We will have ingot and wafer facilities at giga scale commissioned and fully ramped up to 10-gigawatt peak.
guidance.quote: in next few quarters, we will have ingot and wafer both these facilities at the giga scale commissioned and fully ramped up to 10-gigawatt peak during the current year.

scorecard.promised: Tracking annualized EBITDA well over Rs.80,000 Crores for H1 FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Quarterly revenues reached ₹3,30,601 cr in Sep 2026 with 17% operating margin.
scorecard.evidence: Q1 FY27 (Jun 26) revenue ₹309,468 cr at 15% margin plus Q2 FY27 (Sep 26) ₹330,601 cr at 17% margin yields >₹98k cr H1 EBITDA.

scorecard.promised: Double absolute EBITDA number over the next three years (from Q1 FY27).
scorecard.delivered: Pending; full 3-year performance horizon has not elapsed.
scorecard.evidence: Requires sustained EBITDA growth through FY29 against Mar 2026 baseline net profit of ₹95,754 cr.

scorecard.promised: Organic ARPU growth of 5% to 6% per year.
scorecard.evidence: Requires steady 5-6% annualized growth across subscriber base.

scorecard.promised: Target to take FMCG revenue to Rs.1 lakh Crores by FY2030.
scorecard.evidence: Requires scaling from current breakeven status up to ₹1,00,000 cr run-rate by FY30.

scorecard.promised: Earnings contribution from New Energy definitely starting in FY 2028.
scorecard.evidence: Capital work in progress stands at ₹2.33L cr as factories commission.

narrative.scoreline: Management has consistently expanded operating revenues and margins, though long-dated digital and retail earnings targets remain pending.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: All 5G expenses capitalized and actively expensed starting Q1 FY27.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Operating margins remained steady at 15% in Q1 FY27 and expanded to 17% in Q2 FY27 despite expense recognition.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: FMCG business is currently at EBITDA breakeven.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Overall net profit reached ₹23,196 cr in Q1 FY27 and ₹29,550 cr in Q2 FY27, supporting early-stage venture drag.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: O2C and refining balances are structurally positive and tight.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Quarterly revenue grew 29.8% YoY in Sep 2026 with operating margins firming up to 17%.

bull: Annual operating cash flow reached ₹1,92,113 cr in Mar 2026 with a 5-year OCF/PAT ratio of 190%.
Quarterly revenue growth accelerated to 29.8% YoY in Sep 2026 reaching ₹3,30,601 cr.
Free cash flow expanded to ₹70,023 cr in Mar 2026 while debt/equity stayed manageable at 0.43x.
bear: Cash conversion cycle widened to 25 days compared to 7 days three years prior.
Capital work in progress remains elevated at ₹2.33L cr, dragging asset turnover.
Repeated claims on Jio IPO timeline lack concrete dates despite persistent analyst inquiries.
watch: Check if Q3 FY27 operating margin holds at 17% amid retail quick commerce scale-up.
Track reduction in ₹2.33L cr CWIP as new energy factories commission.

claims.claim: The business is structurally positive and well-positioned to benefit from tight global fuel balances.
claims.quote: When you look forward and look at the tight global balance, if you look at the structural supply issues that we have, so we are very, very constructive.

claims.claim: We are trading off short-term earnings growth to build a scalable digital commerce platform.
claims.quote: We have been trading off short term earnings growth to build a very scalable digital commerce platform.

claims.claim: We are at least two to three years ahead of anybody else working on UBR technology.
claims.quote: Case in point, UBR, where we believe we are at least two to three years ahead of anybody else working on that technology.

claims.claim: We have a profitable core and are using that to fund the growth engines, which is online.
claims.quote: Compared to other players who are actually making a loss, we have a profitable core and we are using that to fund the growth engines, which is growth engine, which is online.

claims.claim: We are focusing on ramping up digital commerce and hyperlocal delivery infrastructure to create significant scale.
claims.quote: We are focusing on ramping up digital commerce across verticals. And as we focus on the hyperlocal delivery infrastructure.

claims.claim: All 5G-related expenses and assets have been fully capitalized, meaning they are now being expensed.
claims.quote: as we had spoken last quarter, all of the 5G-related expenses and assets have been fully capitalized. So, all of those are getting expensed now.

claims.claim: The business is currently at breakeven on EBITDA terms.
claims.quote: EBITDA, I would put it across since the concentration there, yes, we are breakeven on EBITDA terms, but EBITDA will improve as a scale

claims.claim: The IPO is imminent and the company is working towards it.
claims.quote: It is fairly imminent. We are working towards it, and we will keep you posted.

claims.claim: The company will continue to build store footprint and increase productivity.
claims.quote: But on net, net, you will continue to see store square footage of stores increasing. And you will also continue to see the productivity increasing.

claims.claim: Refining is structurally tight and cracks are likely to remain reasonably strong.
claims.quote: The market has apprehensions of availability of product. So, we think structurally it is likely to remain reasonably strong.

claims.claim: Digital services are expected to grow faster than connectivity due to a smaller base.
claims.quote: That is expected to grow faster, just because it is growing off a smaller base, the percentage growth will be faster.

claims.claim: We are on track to be the second largest quick commerce player in the country.
claims.quote: and very much on track to be the second largest QC player.

claims.claim: The Jio IPO is imminent and should happen in the next few months.
claims.quote: but it is imminent now, so we are just awaiting the final notification, so it should happen in the next few months for sure.

claims.claim: We are leveraging our existing 3,000 store network to scale quick commerce efficiently.
claims.quote: We are pretty uniquely positioned in the way that we are able to leverage our existing network of 2500, 3000 stores to do quick commerce

risks.text: Significant ongoing legal proceedings with the Government of India and other parties regarding complex matters.
Pending appeal with the Supreme Court regarding trading in shares of Reliance Petroleum Limited.
Revenue recognition complexity due to high volumes of data processed by IT systems.
Financial reporting reliance on IT systems and controls, with increasing cyber security significance.
Impairment risk for brands and goodwill related to the Media - General Entertainment CGU.
